articles.title: Zcash targets November for NU7 mainnet upgrade with 25-second blocks
articles.summary: NU7 will cut Zcash block times to 25 seconds and preserve its halving schedule, with testnet activation planned for Oct. 6.

articles.title: Revolut says no direct contact from hackers after $3M public ransom demand
articles.summary: Revolut says it received no direct contact despite separate ransom demands for $3 million in Monero and 10,000 Bitcoin from competing breach claimants.

articles.title: OG.com cleared by SEC to offer single-stock futures, says Crypto.com CEO
articles.summary: Crypto.com’s CEO said its sister exchange was cleared to offer US access to single-stock perpetual futures, as the latest platform to bridge TradFi and digital assets.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin edges higher as Nasdaq climbs 1.7% in wake of Fed rate hike
articles.summary: The SEC debuted its long-awaited "innovation exemption," providing a roadmap for blockchain-based venues to offer tokenized securities.

articles.title: Bitcoin coils near $76.5K as US stocks rebound from Fed rate hike
articles.summary: Bitcoin made modest daily gains as US stocks saw upside in the aftermath of the US Federal Reserve’s first interest-rate hike since July 2023.

articles.title: Polymarket users referred to prosecutors in South Korea: Report
articles.summary: South Korean police reportedly referred 18 Polymarket users to prosecutors in a gambling probe involving 26 people and $12.7 million in bets.

articles.title: SEC rolls out long-awaited 'innovation exemption' for tokenized securities venues
articles.summary: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission issued a blanket 5-year exemption for listing and trading tokenized securities without registering as an exchange.

articles.title: Solana speeds up blocks by 17%, but transaction capacity stays the same
articles.summary: The network is cutting its target slot time to 250 milliseconds, giving apps fresher blockchain data and validators shorter control windows while reducing the amount of work allowed in each slot.

articles.title: Bank of Japan raises interest rates by 25 basis points. Bitcoin tops $77,000
articles.summary: The yen declined and BTC rose after the BOJ hiked rates to the highest level in 31 years.

articles.title: US sanctions Iran’s BitBank, saying it processes ‘Hormuz Safe’ Bitcoin payments
articles.summary: US Treasury says the Iranian exchange processed payments received through Iran’s Strait of Hormuz maritime scheme and helped move hundreds of millions of dollars in Bitcoin to the IRGC.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Corporate treasuries bought just 5,900 bitcoin in 3 months. Other demand signals look weak, too.
articles.summary: Corporate treasuries bought just 5,900 bitcoin in three months, while broader demand signals remain weak.

articles.title: Ether and XRP ETFs post outflows as bitcoin moves above $77,000
articles.summary: Ether funds shed money for a third straight session even as the token rose, while every major gained and zcash extended its run.

articles.title: SEC Issues “Innovation Exemption” to Facilitate the Trading of Tokenized NMS Stock and Request for Comment
articles.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission today issued an order granting temporary, conditional exemptive relief to Tokenized Securities Venues each a “TSV” from the definition of “exchange” in the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (Exchange Act) to trade…

articles.title: World launches self-custodial ‘super app’ World Money
articles.summary: World Money is rolling out across more than 150 countries, combining stablecoin payments, digital asset rewards and trading in a self-custodial app.

articles.title: WisdomTree, MoonPay team up to expand US access to tokenized money market fund
articles.summary: MoonPay plans to use WisdomTree’s $1.2 billion WTGXX tokenized fund as part of its stablecoin reserves while helping expand access to US investors.

articles.title: State hackers drive 420% surge in onchain malware, Chainalysis finds
articles.summary: North Korea-linked hackers used Tron, Aptos and BNB Chain to maintain malware infrastructure, while suspected Iran-linked actors embedded directions in Bitcoin transactions.

articles.title: Ratings giant S&P Global acquires OpenZeppelin in tokenized finance risk push
articles.summary: Building on its recent market-data investment in Kaiko, S&P Global’s latest purchase targets the technological risks facing banks and asset managers onchain.

articles.title: Real stocks are finally coming on blockchain. Here’s how the SEC wants it to work
articles.summary: The SEC is giving tokenized stocks a regulated U.S. pathway, while keeping trading volumes, access and issuer rights tightly controlled.

articles.title: SEC opens door to tokenized U.S. stock trading. Here’s who could benefit
articles.summary: The five-year experiment gives DeFi-style trading venues, tokenization firms and liquidity providers a new U.S. pathway while leaving synthetic stock tokens outside the framework.

articles.title: Zcash miner Fortitude taps former Hut 8 CEO to lead ahead of public listing
articles.summary: Former Hut 8 CEO Jaime Leverton will take the helm at Fortitude as the Zcash-focused miner expands its operations and moves toward a planned public listing.

articles.title: U.S. SEC begins prepping for around-the-clock trading that crypto treats as the norm
articles.summary: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission dug into plans for around-the-clock trading in an event on the same morning it approved tokenized securities.

articles.title: Clarity Act failure may hamper U.S. crypto as industry seeks legal clarity elsewhere
articles.summary: The U.S. is likely to lose out to foreign markets in the short term, but SEC and CFTC rules will help underpin the industry.

articles.title: SEC grants temporary exemption for tokenized US stock trading
articles.summary: The SEC’s Innovation Exemption allows limited tokenized US stock trading on onchain venues with trading caps and transparency requirements.

articles.title: S&P Global to acquire blockchain security platform OpenZeppelin
articles.summary: S&P Global agreed to buy OpenZeppelin, which says its smart contracts have facilitated more than $37 trillion in value transfers.

articles.title: Zcash miner Fortitude names former Hut 8 chief Jaime Leverton CEO ahead of Nasdaq deal
articles.summary: Leverton will lead the DCG-owned mining company as it pursues a public listing through its proposed merger with HeartSciences.

articles.title: Bitcoin treasury firms can outperform BTC... but is the risk worth taking?
articles.summary: Bitcoin treasury companies promise to amplify returns over investing in Bitcoin alone, but does the potential upside outweigh the risks to the downside?

articles.title: Ethereum’s upcoming Glamsterdam upgrade clears rehearsal for a big jump in capacity
articles.summary: The test network raised its limit on work per block toward 200 million gas as developers prepare for a proposed October 6 public test.

articles.title: Ethereum confirms Glamsterdam dates, but warns 'fake' builders could stall the chain
articles.summary: Free test ether lets fake builders outbid rivals and withhold transaction payloads, while client teams get half the usual review time before Sepolia.

articles.title: How Circle’s institutional Arc blockchain got taken over by memecoins on day one
articles.summary: Circle blockchain Arc's first day was dominated by memecoins, and the traders behind them had already moved on by Thursday morning.

articles.title: Cardano’s IOG warns users to avoid YouTube channel amid apparent hijack
articles.summary: Input Output Group told users to avoid its YouTube channel after it began livestreaming a suspected AI-manipulated Charles Hoskinson video promising to “double your wealth.”

articles.title: North Korea drives onchain malware surge, CoinEx shuts: Asia Express
articles.summary: North Korea and Iran account for the majority of onchain malware, while Malaysia has been named among the most crypto curious Islamic nations.

articles.title: The Ondo Finance succession crisis gets messier as Kathleen Allman’s daughter alleges ‘dementia’, alcoholism and reckless spending
articles.summary: The estranged daughter of 77-year-old Kathleen Allman has petitioned a Hawaiian court to establish a limited conservatorship to protect her parents’ share of her brother’s stake in Ondo.

articles.title: CFTC expands regulatory relief for passive trading software providers
articles.summary: The US regulator’s move could make it easier for crypto wallets and other apps to offer access to regulated derivatives and prediction markets without registering as introducing brokers.

articles.title: Kevin O’Leary says Congress will revisit Clarity early next year as crypto tax bill advances
articles.summary: The Shark Tank investor says Congress will face pressure to revive crypto market structure legislation as it moves to establish tax rules for digital assets.

articles.title: Is there any chance left to save the CLARITY Act?
articles.summary: CLARITY isn’t dead after failing a key Senate vote, but with time running short and Democrats still demanding changes, its path forward is narrowing.

articles.title: UK signals end of 'light-touch' era with multi-agency raid on peer-to-peer crypto hubs
articles.summary: Increased enforcement coincides with detailed regulatory guidance issued to crypto firms ahead of the full framework taking effect in late 2027.

articles.summary: German crypto adoption is progressing through family offices and wealth managers, while the UK’s retail-facing cryptocurrency market remains “nascent,” according to the researcher.
